import bpy, os, base64
study=bpy.data.collections.get('07 CHATGPT | estudo fachada superior 6 janelas')
assert study and study.objects
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
for o in study.objects:
    o.select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=study.objects[0]
window_found=area_found=region_found=None
for window in bpy.context.window_manager.windows:
    for area in window.screen.areas:
        if area.type=='VIEW_3D':
            region=next((r for r in area.regions if r.type=='WINDOW'),None)
            if region:
                window_found,area_found,region_found=window,area,region
                break
    if area_found: break
assert area_found
with bpy.context.temp_override(window=window_found,screen=window_found.screen,area=area_found,region=region_found):
    bpy.ops.view3d.view_selected(use_all_regions=False)
root=r'C:\mcp-blender\blender_bridge\previews'
out=os.path.join(root,'collab_facade_tiny.jpg')
scene=bpy.context.scene
old=(scene.render.filepath,scene.render.resolution_x,scene.render.resolution_y,scene.render.resolution_percentage,scene.render.image_settings.file_format,scene.render.image_settings.quality)
try:
    scene.render.filepath=out
    scene.render.resolution_x=160
    scene.render.resolution_y=120
    scene.render.resolution_percentage=100
    scene.render.image_settings.file_format='JPEG'
    scene.render.image_settings.quality=15
    with bpy.context.temp_override(window=window_found,screen=window_found.screen,area=area_found,region=region_found):
        bpy.ops.render.opengl(write_still=True,view_context=True)
finally:
    scene.render.filepath,scene.render.resolution_x,scene.render.resolution_y,scene.render.resolution_percentage,scene.render.image_settings.file_format,scene.render.image_settings.quality=old
with open(out,'rb') as f:
    b64=base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode('ascii')
with open(os.path.join(root,'collab_facade_tiny_b64.txt'),'w',encoding='ascii') as f:
    f.write(b64)
print(f'TINY_PREVIEW bytes={os.path.getsize(out)} base64={len(b64)}')
